 The NBA regular season is officially underway, and tonight's headliner will see Philly take on Indy. We've highlighted everything you need to know about how to watch the 76ers vs. Pacers, including global streaming options.
 If you don't want to read any further, you can live stream the 76ers vs. Pacers on ESPN Unlimited in the US and through the NBA League Pass in most regions outside the US. Fans can access their usual streaming options from anywhere with a VPN, like NordVPN .
 How to watch the 76ers vs. Pacers: quick links
 US: ESPN
 ESPN Unlimited ($32/month) 
 YouTube TV (free trial) 
 Fubo (free trial) 
 UK & other countries: NBA League Pass (various) 
 Access subscriptions from anywhere: NordVPN (30-day money-back guarantee) 
 When: Wednesday, October 28 at 7 p.m. ET / 11 p.m. GMT / Thurs. at 7 a.m. AWST
 The reformulated Philadelphia 76ers, helmed by LeBron James, will look to keep their strong start going after a 3-1 start to the season. The 2-2 Indiana Pacers are looking for their first home win this season, but they'll have to do so without newly returned star Tyrese Haliburton, who will sit out tonight's game with a hamstring issue.
 What channel is the 76ers vs. Pacers game on?
 The 76ers vs. Pacers game will air on ESPN in the US. The game is scheduled to tip off on Wednesday at 7 p.m. ET.

 How to watch the 76ers vs. Pacers in the US
 Cord-cutters have several options for live streaming the game. ESPN Unlimited is ESPN's direct streaming counterpart. The streaming platform carries live streams of all ESPN-related networks, including the flagship channel, along with ESPN on ABC programming and streaming-exclusive content. Subscriptions cost $32 a month.
 ESPN Unlimited
 ESPN Unlimited has everything from ESPN Plus, in addition to all that the ESPN linear networks have to offer, along with some exclusive events not found on broadcast channels.
 Check price at ESPN
 If you'd prefer to watch the game on a service that carries other networks beyond just those under the ESPN umbrella, then a live TV streaming service will be of interest. YouTube TV carries ESPN and 100+ channels in its Main plan, which normally costs $83 a month. However, a limited-time deal will knock new customers' first five months down to $68 a month after a free trial. ESPN is also available in YouTube TV's Sports plan.
 YouTube TV Main Plan
 YouTube TV's main plan carries over 100 channels, ranging from local networks to cable favorites.
 Check price at YouTube TV
 Fubo is another one of the best live TV streaming services we've tested. Fubo carries ESPN in multiple plans, including Fubo Pro (200+ channels). Pro typically costs $89 a month, but new users can get $25 off their first month after a free trial.
 Fubo Pro
 Fubo is the streaming service for sports fans. Its huge library of channels includes regional and international sports leagues, setting it apart from the competition. You can also tack on additional programming to your plan, but it'll cost you extra.
 Check price at Fubo
 How to watch the 76ers vs. Pacers from anywhere
 In most regions outside the US, the NBA League Pass offers comprehensive live streams of NBA games all season long. Subscription prices vary from country to country.
 If you happen to be traveling through an area where you're unable to access your usual streaming methods, you can still do so with the help of a VPN. Short for virtual private networks, VPNs are easy-to-use tech tools that let people temporarily alter their virtual locations. This way, their favorite websites and apps work from anywhere — just like they would back home. Since the services we've recommended require country-specific payment methods, this option will work best for those who are simply traveling abroad at the moment.
 NordVPN is our top recommendation. It's fast and user-friendly (even for beginners). Plus, it comes with a 30-day money-back guarantee. You can learn more about the service in our NordVPN review .
 NordVPN subscription
 NordVPN is top of the pile of the best VPN services. It offers excellent value, with a strong feature set and a low monthly price. A wide selection of international servers, high-end security, fast connections, and audited privacy protection have made the brand a household name in the world of VPNs for a reason.
 Check price at NordVPN
 See also: Where to watch the World Series | ESPN streaming service 
 Where will the 76ers vs. Pacers game take place?
 The Pacers will host tonight's game at Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis.
 Who is favored to win the 76ers vs. Pacers game?
 The 76ers are the 7.5-point favorites to win tonight's game. On DraftKings (at the time of writing), the 76ers are -278 on the moneyline, while the Pacers are +225.
 Note: The use of VPNs is illegal in certain countries, and using VPNs to access region-locked streaming content might constitute a breach of the terms of use for certain services. Business Insider does not endorse or condone the illegal use of VPNs.
